metadata.description: Marketplace for the writing-english-prose plugin: a skill that removes AI tells from English prose and targets fluent, natural US English.

plugins.name: writing-english-prose
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from English prose, or flag them without rewriting. Use when drafting, editing, reviewing, or proofreading US-English text (essays, posts, docs, emails, UI strings, locale files), and when asked whether a text sounds AI-written. Fluent, natural American English.
